title: Presets Configuration
description: Configuration file for torrent creation presets

default.description: Default settings that apply to all presets unless overridden

piece_length.description: Piece length as 2^n bytes (14-27, the tracker rules can narrow it)

max_piece_length.description: Maximum piece length as 2^n bytes (14-27, the tracker rules can narrow it)

target_piece_count.description: Target approximate number of pieces (calculates optimal piece length). Mutually exclusive with piece_length.

entropy.description: Randomize the info hash by adding an entropy field

skip_prefix.description: Leave out the filename prefix from the output filename

fail_on_season_warning.description: Exit with error if season pack completeness check detects missing episodes

output_dir.description: Output folder for the .torrent file. --output-dir overrides it.

workers.description: Number of goroutines that hash pieces. 0 picks the count automatically.

exclude_patterns.description: List of glob patterns to exclude files (e.g., "*.nfo", "*sample*")

include_patterns.description: List of glob patterns to include files (e.g., "*.mkv", "*video*")

presets.description: Map of preset names to their configurations
